planka_card_due_trigger.description: Runs when a card on a board comes within the hours you choose of its due date, once for each due date, such as to remind its members. Cards whose due date is ticked as done, or in a closed list, don't count. Cards already that close, or overdue, when the workflow is turned on start it too.
